effects: The signer's whole current ARB balance counts as voting power for `delegatee`, and future ARB the signer receives follows the same delegate.
The previous delegate of the signer loses the signer's voting power (the single delegate slot is replaced).
If `delegatee` is the zero address, the signer's delegation is removed and the signer's voting power goes to nobody.
The signer's shared permit/delegation nonce is used up, so a pending permit with the same nonce becomes invalid.
Anyone can submit the signature until `expiry`. No tokens move and no allowance changes.
formats.shown: The intent says "Delegate ARB voting power". It shows the delegatee as a raw address, the nonce as a raw number and the expiry as a raw integer timestamp.

findings.title: Delegation shows expiry as a raw integer, not a date.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, Delegation format: {"path": "expiry", "label": "Expiry", "format": "raw"}. ERC20VotesUpgradeable.delegateBySig: require(block.timestamp <= expiry, "ERC20Votes: signature expired"); so expiry is a unix timestamp.

findings.title: Delegation shows the delegatee as a raw address instead of addressName.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, Delegation format: {"path": "delegatee", "label": "Delegatee", "format": "raw"}. ERC20VotesUpgradeable._delegate: _delegates[delegator] = delegatee; the delegatee receives all of the signer's voting power.
findings.fix: Use {"path": "delegatee", "label": "Delegate to", "format": "addressName", "params": {"types": ["eoa", "contract"], "sources": ["local", "ens"]}}. Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Delegate ARB voting power to {delegatee}".

findings.title: Delegation to the zero address removes the delegation, but the screen shows it as a normal delegation.
findings.evidence: ERC20VotesUpgradeable._moveVotingPower: if (dst != address(0)) {...} so delegatee = 0 removes the signer's votes from every delegate. The intent "Delegate ARB voting power" does not cover this case.
findings.fix: The address formats have no way to label the zero address. Wallets can name the zero address when they render the delegatee.

findings.title: Delegation has no test case, including the zero-address undelegate path.
findings.evidence: FORMATS.md: Delegation(address delegatee,uint256 nonce,uint256 expiry) - cases: 0 (no tx).
findings.fix: Add an EIP-712 test with a normal delegatee and one with delegatee = 0x000…0.
